name: Nagakura Shinpachi
source:
The Genbu of Heaven from the realm of Chobaku

Captain of Shinsengumi's Second Unit. 24 years old
Greatest swordsman of Shinsengumi. Though is good at socializing, he is a man who rarely express his emotions
Loves napping and always yawning.
